##### Project general facts

Damac Hills – Park Town is a residential development located within the DAMAC Hills master community, offering a collection of apartments and townhouses surrounded by extensive landscaped parkland. The project consists of three contemporary glass-fronted low-rise buildings — Jasmine, Loreto, and Orchid — designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views of the surrounding greenery. With nearly four million square feet of landscaped open spaces around the development, Park Town creates a peaceful and nature-oriented residential environment within one of Dubai’s most established communities.

The project benefits from the wide range of lifestyle and leisure amenities available throughout DAMAC Hills, including parks, walking areas, sports facilities, retail outlets, and golf-oriented attractions connected to the Trump International Golf Club Dubai. Large terraces and expansive windows enhance the connection between indoor and outdoor living, while the community atmosphere focuses on relaxation, greenery, and family-friendly comfort. Its suburban setting offers residents a calm environment while maintaining accessibility to major areas across Dubai.

The interiors are designed with spacious layouts that balance functionality and contemporary aesthetics, creating comfortable living spaces filled with natural light. Kitchens are fully equipped, and the residences are delivered fully furnished, including studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments as well as townhouses. The overall interior concept emphasizes convenience and ready-to-move-in comfort within a modern residential setting.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills is an exquisite community nestled within the heart of Dubai. Known for its luxurious living and world-class amenities, this prestigious development spans over 42 million square feet and offers a wide range of residential options, including villas, townhouses, and apartments. Designed to provide residents with a lavish and convenient lifestyle, Damac Hills combines stunning architecture, meticulously landscaped surroundings, and an array of leisure facilities.

The community of Damac Hills is meticulously planned to offer residents a wealth of amenities and services. The Trump International Golf Club, designed by golf legend Tiger Woods, serves as the centerpiece of the community and provides residents with an unrivaled golfing experience. In addition to golf, Damac Hills features lush green parks, jogging tracks, and cycling paths, encouraging an active and healthy lifestyle.

Damac Hills is not just a residential community; it also caters to the needs of its residents through its vast range of retail outlets, gourmet restaurants, and state-of-the-art fitness centers. The community's vibrant atmosphere is further complemented by its entertainment offerings, including the luxurious Damac Hills Drive-In Cinema and the popular Carrefour supermarket, ensuring that residents have access to all their daily needs and entertainment options within close proximity.
